title: 385. Game of Life

examples.explanation: Standard glider step computed simultaneously from live-neighbor counts.
Three live cells around the dead corner bring it to life.
A lone dead cell stays dead.

hints: Adaptation: the original updates in place with void; here return the next board.
Count the eight neighbors for each cell from a snapshot before writing any change.
Live survives with 2-3 neighbors; dead becomes live with exactly 3.
